chunks: "Three people are not prayed behind: the unknown one, the extremist, even if he speaks according to your belief, and the one who openly commits fisq, even if he is moderate."

key_terms.اَلْغَالِي: an extremist who exceeds proper bounds in belief
key_terms.اَلْمَجْهُولُ: a person whose condition or religious standing is unknown
key_terms.اَلْمُجَاهِرُ: one who acts openly and publicly
key_terms.بِالْفِسْقِ: with sinful conduct or open disobedience
key_terms.بِقَوْلِكَ: according to your stated belief or doctrine

ai.seo_question: Who should not be followed as an Imam in congregational prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that congregational salat should not be performed behind three types of people: one whose religious state is unknown, an extremist in belief, and one who openly displays sinful conduct. The hadith indicates the importance of reliability in creed and outward conduct for the leadership of prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1110 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Three people should not be prayed behind: the one who is unknown (al-majhūl), the extremist (al-ghālī) even if he claims to hold your beliefs, and the one who openly commits sinful acts (al-mujāhir bil-fisq) even if he appears moderate."
